feature.caustica.bloom.description: Spread light from bright areas into their surroundings.
feature.caustica.minecraft.description: Sun and moon, sky brightness, and volumetric fog.
caustica.page.reset_page.tooltip: Restore every option on this page to its default.
caustica.page.tone-mapping.tooltip: The SDR or HDR tone mapper and its controls, HDR output and brightness, and gamma.
caustica.page.exposure.tooltip: Auto or manual exposure, compensation and adaptation speed, with the meter's internals under Advanced.
caustica.page.upscaling.tooltip: The denoiser and the quality of the upscaler it uses, frame generation, and latency.
caustica.page.radiance-cache.tooltip: NVIDIA SHaRC's world-space cache of indirect light, with its size, grid and accumulation under Advanced.
caustica.page.overlays.tooltip: Entity glow and block outlines, debug views, and EXR screenshots.
caustica.setting.enabled.tooltip: Replace the raster renderer with the path tracer. Turning this off returns Minecraft to vanilla rendering.
caustica.setting.composite.max-bounces.t: Maximum secondary bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light at more cost.
caustica.setting.composite.water-waves.t: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.setting.sharc.enabled.tooltip: End indirect paths at NVIDIA SHaRC's world-space radiance cache instead of tracing them further. Needs a build made with the SHaRC SDK and a GPU with 64-bit buffer atomics and 16-bit storage.
caustica.setting.sharc.cache-exponent.to: Entries per cache table as a power of two. Each step doubles the memory; 2^22 entries use 256 MiB.
The cache update traces one pixel of every tile this wide each frame, so each pixel is traced once per size-squared frames. Smaller tiles refresh faster and cost more.
caustica.setting.sharc.accumulation-fram: Frames of samples each cache entry averages. More frames give a smoother cache that follows lighting changes more slowly.
caustica.setting.sharc.stale-frames.tool: Frames an entry stays in the cache without new samples before it is evicted.
caustica.setting.sharc.scene-scale.toolt: Voxel density of the cache grid. Higher values give smaller voxels and finer indirect lighting that takes longer to converge.
caustica.setting.sharc.grid-logarithm-ba: Voxel size ratio between adjacent distance levels. Higher values coarsen the cache faster with distance from the camera.
caustica.setting.sharc.grid-level-bias.t: Positive values add finer voxel levels near the camera; negative values keep the finest voxels larger.
caustica.setting.sharc.radiance-scale.to: Accumulator steps per unit of exposure-relative radiance. Higher values resolve dim light more finely; lower values leave more headroom for very bright light.
caustica.setting.sharc.roughness-thresho: Surfaces at or below this roughness never use the cache. Zero lets every non-mirror dielectric surface use it.
caustica.setting.sharc.anti-firefly.tool: Scale down rare samples far brighter than a converged cache entry before they enter it.
caustica.setting.tonemap.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Below 1 brightens shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and colour ratios.
caustica.setting.denoising.route.tooltip: Choose raw path tracing, NRD temporal denoising, or DLSS Ray Reconstruction.
caustica.setting.denoising.method.toolti: Choose which NRD denoiser to use with the temporal denoising route.
caustica.setting.dlss-rr.quality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower modes render fewer pixels and upscale harder for framerate; higher modes render more for sharpness.
caustica.setting.dlss-rr.responsivity.to: How strongly Ray Reconstruction favors the newest frame over its accumulated history. 0 gives the steadiest image; higher values react faster to lighting changes but show more noise. Sky seen directly or through glass and water always uses the newest frame.
caustica.setting.dlss-sr.quality.tooltip: DLSS Super Resolution quality mode: the render resolution used before NRD output is reconstructed to display resolution.
caustica.setting.frame-generation.enable: Generate intermediate frames with DLSS. Raises framerate without lowering latency.
caustica.setting.reflex.enabled.tooltip: Reduce input latency by pacing frame submission. Requires supported NVIDIA hardware.
caustica.setting.exposure.mode.tooltip: Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual holds the exposure value directly.
caustica.setting.exposure.response.toolt: How auto exposure follows scene brightness. Adaptation keeps noon at key, renders darker scenes darker at one fifth of their brightness ratio, and holds nights dark. Curve brightens daylight and lifts nights.
caustica.setting.exposure.manual-ev.tool: Positive values brighten; negative values darken. Sets exposure in Manual and adjusts automatic exposure in Auto.
caustica.setting.exposure.key.tooltip: Display value the metered scene average maps to. Higher values brighten automatic exposure.
caustica.setting.exposure.adapt-darken.t: Time constant, in seconds, for adapting to a scene that got darker.
caustica.setting.exposure.adapt-brighten: Time constant, in seconds, for adapting to a scene that got brighter.
caustica.setting.exposure.low-percentile: Metering ignores histogram samples darker than this percentile.
caustica.setting.exposure.high-percentil: Metering ignores histogram samples brighter than this percentile.
caustica.setting.exposure.stride.tooltip: Meter every Nth pixel in each direction. Higher values cost less.
caustica.setting.exposure.center-weight-: Width of the center-weighted metering falloff, relative to the view. Larger values weight more of the frame evenly.
Metering weight kept at the edges of the view. 100% meters the whole frame uniformly.
caustica.setting.exposure.environment-we: Largest share of the meter that sky and other environment pixels may hold, so open sky does not darken the terrain.
caustica.setting.exposure.emissive-weigh: Largest share of the meter that light-emitting surfaces may hold, so lava or glowstone in view does not darken the scene.
caustica.setting.exposure.pre-exposure.t: Scale traced radiance by the previous exposure before storing it at half precision and divide it back out before display. Toggling this does not change the image.
caustica.setting.hdr.enabled.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) output. Requires operating system and display support.
caustica.setting.hdr.ui-nits.tooltip: Absolute brightness, in nits, given to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.setting.hdr.peak-nits.tooltip: Brightness, in nits, highlights roll off toward. Set this to your display's peak HDR brightness; ACES 2.0 renders through the nearest of its 500, 1000, 2000, and 4000 nit LUTs.
caustica.setting.sdr.tone-mapper.tooltip: Display rendering operator for SDR output. ACES 2.0 renders through the reference LUTs with the scene look; the other mappers run on the exposed scene-linear signal and own their complete display rendering.
caustica.setting.hdr.tone-mapper.tooltip: Display rendering operator for HDR output. ACES 2.0 renders through the reference LUTs; the other mappers render paper-white-referred colour analytically toward the display peak.
caustica.setting.sdr.agx.contrast.toolti: Contrast around the middle of the display range after the AgX curve. 1 leaves AgX unchanged.
caustica.setting.sdr.agx.saturation.tool: Saturation after the AgX curve. 1 leaves AgX unchanged, 0 is grayscale.
caustica.setting.sdr.pbr-neutral.start-c: Display level where highlight compression begins. Lower values compress more of the range.
caustica.setting.sdr.pbr-neutral.desatur: How strongly compressed highlights desaturate toward white.
caustica.setting.sdr.reinhard.white-poin: Scene luminance mapped to display white. Higher values keep more highlight detail.
caustica.setting.sdr.aces.exposure.toolt: Scale applied to the scene before the Narkowicz ACES fit. 1 leaves exposure unchanged.
caustica.setting.sdr.lottes.shoulder.too: How quickly the Lottes curve compresses highlights toward white.
caustica.setting.sdr.lottes.hdr-max.tool: Scene luminance the Lottes curve maps to display white.
caustica.setting.sdr.lottes.mid-in.toolt: Scene luminance the Lottes curve maps to Mid-Gray Out.
caustica.setting.sdr.lottes.mid-out.tool: Display value Mid-Gray In maps to.
caustica.setting.sdr.uncharted2.a.toolti: Hable's coefficient A: shoulder strength of the Uncharted 2 curve.
caustica.setting.sdr.uncharted2.b.toolti: Hable's coefficient B: strength of the linear section.
caustica.setting.sdr.uncharted2.c.toolti: Hable's coefficient C: angle of the linear section.
caustica.setting.sdr.uncharted2.white-po: Scene luminance the Uncharted 2 curve maps to display white.
caustica.setting.sdr.gt.linear-start.too: Luminance where the linear section begins; the toe shapes values below it.
caustica.setting.sdr.gt.linear-length.to: Length of the linear section before the shoulder.
caustica.setting.sdr.gt.black-curve.tool: Curvature of the toe. Higher values darken shadows.
caustica.setting.sdr.gt.black-lift.toolt: Pedestal added to shadows. Negative values darken blacks.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.compre: Highlight compression exponent. 0 derives it from the display peak.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.gamut-: Strength of the gamut squeeze toward the BT.2020 primaries.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.highli: Above 1 brightens highlights, below 1 darkens them.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.shadow: Above 1 lifts shadows, below 1 deepens them.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.contra: Contrast of the tone response. 1 leaves it unchanged.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.purity: Colorfulness kept through tone compression. 1 keeps the source's, 0 is grayscale.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychovisual.hue-re: How much of the source hue the highlight roll-off restores.
caustica.setting.sdr.prism.compression.t: Shape of the highlight shoulder between the anchor and the display peak.
caustica.setting.sdr.prism.anchor.toolti: Working-space level below which values pass through unchanged.
caustica.setting.sdr.prism.model-red-x.t: CIE x chromaticity of the red primary of Prism's working space.
caustica.setting.sdr.prism.model-red-y.t: CIE y chromaticity of the red primary of Prism's working space.
caustica.setting.sdr.prism.model-green-x: CIE x chromaticity of the green primary of Prism's working space.
caustica.setting.sdr.prism.model-green-y: CIE y chromaticity of the green primary of Prism's working space.
CIE x chromaticity of the blue primary of Prism's working space.
CIE y chromaticity of the blue primary of Prism's working space.
caustica.setting.sdr.reinhard-jodie.whit: Scene luminance mapped to display white. Per-channel Reinhard blends toward luminance Reinhard as a pixel brightens.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychov31.compressi: Strength of the highlight shoulder. PsychoV 31 has no automatic compression.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychov31.gamut-com: Strength of the gamut compression toward the display's BT.709 primaries.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychov31.highlight: Above 1 brightens highlights, below 1 darkens them.
caustica.setting.sdr.psychov31.shadows.t: Above 1 lifts shadows, below 1 deepens them.

caustica.setting.sdr.psychov31.source-aw: Blends from mapping toward the target gamut only (0) to mapping along the source gamut boundary (1).

caustica.setting.hdr.paper-white-nits.to: Brightness, in nits, given to diffuse white by the analytic HDR tone mappers. Highlights roll off from here toward the display peak.
One of the two tone mappers the Toggle Tone Mapper key switches between. A mapper the SDR or HDR output does not offer leaves that output's selection unchanged.

caustica.setting.entities.enabled.toolti: Include entities and block entities in the traced scene.
caustica.setting.particles.enabled.toolt: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.setting.entities.glow.enabled.t: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline, through walls, around glowing entities.
caustica.setting.overlay.block-outline.e: Draw the selection outline around the block you are looking at.
caustica.setting.composite.debug-view.to: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
caustica.setting.screenshots.exr-enabled: Save a scene-linear ACEScg EXR alongside the normal PNG when you take a screenshot.
caustica.setting.sharc.primary-surface-d: Directly visible surfaces read the SHaRC cache too, so its content appears on screen.
caustica.option.caustica.bloom.bloom.ena: Bleed light from bright areas into their surroundings.
caustica.option.caustica.bloom.bloom.str: Brightness of the glow around bright areas.
caustica.option.caustica.bloom.bloom.thr: Scene-linear luminance a pixel must exceed before it blooms.
caustica.option.caustica.bloom.bloom.sof: Softens the threshold so pixels fade into blooming instead of snapping.
caustica.option.caustica.bloom.bloom.rad: How far the glow spreads around bright areas.
caustica.option.caustica.bloom.bloom.lev: Number of blur levels. More levels spread the glow farther across the screen.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.sky.s: How far south of overhead the sun sits at noon, in degrees. Higher gives longer shadows year-round.
Apparent radius of the sun as a light source, in degrees. Larger softens shadow edges.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.sky.m: Apparent radius of the moon as a light source, in degrees.
How much light the full moon casts, in lux. The physical value is 0.3; raise it for brighter nights, or set 0 for a moonless sky lit only by airglow and stars.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.sky.s: How large the sun sprite is drawn, in degrees. Does not change how much light it casts.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.sky.m: How large the moon sprite is drawn, in degrees.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.sky.g: How much light the ground bounces back into the sky. Raising it brightens the whole atmosphere.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.sky.h: How far the horizon is blurred, in degrees, to hide the hard edge of the sky model.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.fog.e: Add drifting mist that varies with time of day, terrain height, and biome.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.fog.d: Scale the thickness of the mist. Higher values reduce visibility.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.fog.r: Lower values sharpen fog around terrain and trees at a higher GPU cost.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.fog.s: Higher values reduce integration noise at a higher GPU cost.
caustica.option.caustica.minecraft.fog.d: Show the normal image, the fog's transmittance, or only its scattered light.
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.started: Ultra screenshot started: DLAA accumulation over one full jitter phase (F4 to cancel)
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.requires: Ultra screenshot requires a loaded world
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.busy: Ultra screenshot: a capture or screenshot write is already active
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.requires: Ultra screenshot requires the DLSS Ray Reconstruction route and no debug view
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.invalida: Ultra screenshot cancelled: world or renderer settings changed
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.timedOut: Ultra screenshot timed out waiting for fresh frames
